metadata.title: nilearn
metadata.description:
Nilearn enables approachable and versatile analyses of brain volumes.
It provides statistical and machine-learning tools,
with instructive documentation & friendly community.

additional_descriptions.description: If you use this software, please cite it as below.

access_status.description_l10n: The record and files are publicly accessible.
